about: Psalm 129 in Vulgate numbering (Psalm 130 in Hebrew numbering), traditionally prayed for the dead. Its Latin is the Gallican psalter, the version the Roman liturgy prays.

seg.tr: From the depths I called out to You, O Lord.
May Your ears listen closely to my pleading voice.
If You take note of iniquities, O Lord, Lord, who could stand?
For with You there is forgiveness; for the sake of Your law I have waited for You, O Lord.
My soul has waited for His word; my soul has hoped in the Lord.
From the morning watch until night, let Israel hope in the Lord.
For mercy is with the Lord, and abundant redemption is with Him.
And He Himself will redeem Israel from all its iniquities.
